content:
Adds tons of art and extras to Pixelmon Reforged and more mods. 

 

  • custom pokemon npc's, shopkeepers and buildings!
  • Perfect IV Shiny starters with extra starter options! 
  • Daycare's require no items
  • Sprigatito, Fuecoco and Quaxly naturally spawn!
  • Blue, Pink and Galaxy Palettes spawn in the world! More for your players to collect!
  • Custom SNG Palette available on some Pokemon and can be manually added (Umbreon, Sylveon, Braviory, Blastoise, Pikachu, Eevee and Absol).
  • Apricon and Berry tree's are in x128 resolution!
  • 128x resolution art support for byg, biomes o plenty, forbidden arcanus, pixelmon, quark and t-construct
  • Blaze heads and Wither skulls are both in pokemon drops and can be crafted!

 

If this side-mod doesn't seem to be overwriting the art files or other existing Pixelmon files, please use our data pack and install it on your server. That should fix it. If it doesn't, you are welcome to download and use the resource pack as well. <3 Feel free to contact us with any questions!
